in_english.name: Khurrah
in_english.meaning: Khurrah means the part of water that is received by the earth
in_english.long_meaning: Khurrah is an Islamic name that has a rich meaning in Arabic. It means the part of water that is received by the earth, which is a significant concept in Islam. In the Quran, the term khurrah is used in Surah Al-Ma'ida, verse 87. The name Khurrah is derived from the Arabic root kh-r-r, which means to collect or gather. In Islamic tradition, Khurrah is considered a symbol of good deeds and generosity. It is also associated with the concept of tawbah, or repentance, which is a central theme in Islamic theology. In modern times, the name Khurrah has gained popularity in various Muslim cultures, including Arabic, Urdu, and Turkish. It is often given to children born during times of drought or water scarcity, as a symbol of hope and renewal.
